Initial release of 4K Subtitle Generator — generates captions for 4K videos using cloud GPU processing.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB and generate subtitle-embedded 4K MP4s.
- Automatic setup: connects to backend, handles anonymous token/auth, and session management.
- Fast, remote subtitle rendering for YouTubers and creators; typical turnaround 1–2 minutes per video.
- File upload, export, credits, and session state supported via simple chat prompts.
- Error handling includes token expiry, unsupported files, size limits, and credits.
- Clear feedback, timeline state summaries, and step-by-step workflow guidance.
